title: Detailed pair of scissors
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Left blade -->
  <polygon points="30,82 44,55 50,57 38,84" fill="#B8C6D9"/>
  <polygon points="30,82 44,55 47,56 34,82" fill="#D6E3F0"/>
  <!-- Right blade -->
  <polygon points="70,82 56,55 50,57 62,84" fill="#9AAABF"/>
  <polygon points="70,82 56,55 53,56 66,82" fill="#C5D3E3"/>
  <!-- Blade edges highlight -->
  <line x1="44" y1="55" x2="31" y2="81" stroke="#EAF2FA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="55" x2="69" y2="81" stroke="#EAF2FA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <!-- Pivot screw -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="57" r="4" fill="#7C8DA3"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="57" r="2.5" fill="#A7B8CC"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="57" r="1.2" fill="#EAF2FA"/>
  <!-- Left handle -->
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="88" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <ellipse cx="25" cy="88" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#8B1A3A"/>
  <ellipse cx="24" cy="87" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#5A0E24"/>
  <!-- Right handle -->
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="88" rx="12" ry="9" fill="#FF8F6B"/>
  <ellipse cx="75" cy="88" rx="7" ry="5.5" fill="#8B3A1A"/>
  <ellipse cx="76" cy="87" rx="5" ry="3.5" fill="#5A2410"/>
  <!-- Handle connection to blades -->
  <polygon points="33,82 38,84 34,80 29,79" fill="#FF6B8A"/>
  <polygon points="67,82 62,84 66,80 71,79" fill="#FF8F6B"/>
  <!-- Handles shine -->
  <ellipse cx="21" cy="84" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" fill="#FFD1DC" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="79" cy="84" rx="2.5" ry="1.5" fill="#FFE0D1" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- Sparkles -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="44" r="1.5" fill="#FFF9A0"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="40" r="1" fill="#FFF9A0"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="40" r="1" fill="#FFF9A0"/>
</svg>
